subject: Timezone-aware on-call carveout & escalation plan for ServiceBridge integration
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@servicebridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@servicebridge.com
Date: Sat, 20 Apr 2029 17:15:00 -0400
Subject: Request: Nighttime P1/P2 coverage carveout — Redwood integration

Hi Ben,

Quick note from our ops team: we’re going live in APAC next month and we expect a spike in overnight traffic for the first three weeks. Our incident runs show that Redwood’s current P1/P2 response windows (US-centric rota) mean that we have delayed handoffs overnight in IST/AEST.

Can Redwood support a temporary timezone-aware carveout so that we have dedicated on-call shadowing from 22:00–06:00 SGT (UTC+8) for the launch period (3 weeks starting May 6)? Specifically we need:
- P1 acknowledgement within 15 minutes (same as standard) but with APAC-based responders for the carveout window
- P2 acknowledgement within 60 minutes during the carveout window
- A clear escalation ladder (who to page next if no response in 15/60)

We understand this is an exception request — happy to sign an amendment or accept a limited SLA credit if needed. Attaching our internal launch roster and a short run-of-show.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Ops, ServiceBridge
attachments: timezone-oncall-roster.pdf (stub), servicebridge-launch-runbook.pdf (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@servicebridge.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, ops@servicebridge.com
Date: Sun, 21 Apr 2029 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Nighttime P1/P2 coverage carveout — Redwood integration

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and the roster. We can support a temporary carveout but want to make the operational boundaries explicit so we don’t overcommit during the high-risk launch. Proposal below (I copied Lauren and Rishi to confirm operational & commercial sign-off):

Proposed carveout (3 weeks, 2029-05-06 to 2029-05-26):
- Coverage window: 22:00–06:00 SGT (UTC+8)
- P1: Acknowledge within 15 minutes; actionable triage within 30 minutes.
- P2: Acknowledge within 60 minutes; triage within 120 minutes.
- Primary responder: APAC shadow (on-call) backed by US hot-seat if escalation required.
- Escalation ladder: APAC primary -> APAC lead -> US on-call -> Eng SRE pager -> Ben Carter (exec)
- Deliverables from Redwood: a short runbook, a shared PagerDuty escalation policy, and an on-call contact sheet.

Commercial/credits: we’ll treat this as a time-boxed operational exception with a small SLA credit if any P1 breaches occur attributable to Redwood coverage failure during the carveout window. Lauren — can legal/finance provide the wording for the amendment + credit band? Rishi — ops/rota changes — can your team staff APAC shadowing or do we need to recruit temporary coverage?

If that looks reasonable I’ll send a one-page amendment (DocuSign) and a companion ops checklist.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
attachments: servicebridge-sla-carveout-request.docx (stub)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <elena@servicebridge.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 21 Apr 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Nighttime P1/P2 coverage carveout — Redwood integration

Ben / Elena — I approve the time-boxed carveout with the escalation ladder Ben outlined. A few notes from legal/commercial: 
- Amendment should be a 1-page schedule to the MSA that limits the carveout to the stated dates and defines the SLA credit formula for P1 failure (credit = pro-rated monthly fee * 0.15 per qualifying breach, capped at 30% of monthly host fees for the period).
- We’ll require acceptance from an ops sponsor at ServiceBridge for any post-launch adjustments.

Marissa: can you add the amendment language to the DocuSign template and route to Elena? I’ll approve the credit bands.

Elena: please confirm the final start date and provide the APAC roster (names + phone) by 2029-04-26 so Rishi can finalize staffing.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@servicebridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 21 Apr 2029 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Nighttime P1/P2 coverage carveout — Redwood integration

Elena / Team — operational acceptance and quick notes from the on-call side: 
- We can staff APAC shadowing for the requested window for the 3-week window, using a mix of APAC-based contractors and rotated US responders.
- I’ll publish a temporary PagerDuty escalation policy:
  1) APAC primary (30 min) -> 2) APAC lead (15 min) -> 3) US hot-seat (15 min) -> 4) SRE escalation (page) -> 5) Exec on-call (Ben)
- Runbook items I’ll deliver by 2029-04-28:
  - Step-by-step triage checklist for P1/P2
  - Rollback triggers and quick mitigation playbook (for model-serving latency spikes)
  - Contact sheet & communication headers for post-incident notes

Elena — if you can confirm roster and the confirmed start date I’ll schedule the temporary rota and share the PagerDuty policy link. Also flagging that after two P1 breaches attributed to our infra in the carveout window we’ll move to a joint war-room cadence (daily 09:00 SGT).

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Support Operations — Redwood Inference
